label: captive
note: Held in a prison cell (C22). Lowers the prisoner's mood, so wardens' talks work a little worse.

label: was captured
note: The prisoner, when it is laid in its cell (C22).

label: someone talked to me
note: The prisoner, after a warden's talk (C22).

label: a prisoner was executed
note: Every colonist, when a warden executes a prisoner (C22 leftovers).

label: a colonist was executed
note: Every colonist, when a warden executes one of the colony's own arrested colonists (C22 leftovers).
